title: Resolution urging Albany to fund immigrant legal defense
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass and the Governor to sign the BUILD Act (A.2689/S.4538), which would create competitive grants to expand legal representation for immigrants facing deportation. The measure aims to build workforce capacity and legal services infrastructure amid rising immigration enforcement. It cites increased need, including over 5,400 Haitians in New York City who lost protected status.
